item.title: Approve the Phase 0 corpus phrase list
item.agent_text:
## Phrase list

- 40 peer and repository names
- 20 issue and pull request numbers
- 15 verdict words: approve, reject, confirm
- 25 free sentences

You read it twice: once quiet, once with noise.
item.context: The list is 100 phrases and takes about 12 minutes to read.
